notes: training_steps are simulator steps; steps_counted is what SB3 counted (decentral runs count 2 duck entries per simulator step)
git_commit is the commit that recorded the run's results on its branch
running a policy also needs the frozen walk/push ONNX policies: sh scripts/fetch_policies.sh

the d2-push-l2-s2 and d2-rendezvous-r6-s1 assets were added to the release on 2026-11-25; their test_set numbers are on 200 starts with cooperative success (each duck at least 25% of the contact impulse) next to task success

policies.name: stage1-central
policies.description: Central controller (one network commands both ducks), stage 1: random box starts (up to 15 cm, 45 deg), warm-started from 01_reference.
policies.use: warm start for long-turn work on the stage 1 range

test_set.note: one deterministic episode per start, 50 random box starts (stage 1 range)

policies.name: stage1-d2
policies.description: D2: each duck runs the same network on its own view plus the partner's position and heading; phase 2 on stage 1 random box starts.
policies.use: warm start for stage 2 (decentralized, partner in view)

test_set.note: one deterministic episode per start, 50 random box starts (stage 1 range)

policies.name: 01_reference
policies.description: Central controller, fixed in-contact start (overnight layout: target 0.60 m ahead, 0.30 m right), seed 1.
policies.use: warm start for stage 1 runs; the central from-scratch baseline

test_set.note: one deterministic episode per start, 50 random box starts (stage 1 range)

policies.name: d2-push-l2-s2
policies.description: D2 push policy (each duck runs the same network on its own view plus the partner's position and heading, with the stand-still action), night 5 run L2 seed 2: trained with L2 duck start noise, warm-started from night 2 run A seed 2.
policies.use: the official frozen push policy the rendezvous hands off to; warm start for heavy-box work

test_set.note: one deterministic episode per start, 200 clean stage 1 starts; experiments/d2-steering/night5/SUMMARY.md

policies.name: d2-rendezvous-r6-s1
policies.description: D2 rendezvous policy, r6 (docking payout) seed 1, final checkpoint at 2M steps: each duck walks from 0.2 to 0.8 m away to its docking spot behind the box, then hands off to d2-push-l2-s2. Includes bc.zip, the behavioral-cloning policy it was warm-started from.

test_set.note: full pipeline (rendezvous, then d2-push-l2-s2), one deterministic episode per start; experiments/d2-rendezvous/r6-dock-payout/SUMMARY.md

policies.name: d2-push-heavy-h1-s2
policies.description: D2 push policy for the heavy box (0.60 kg, 130-step push limit, reward v1.1-t130): d2-push-l2-s2 fine-tuned on that box with L2 duck start noise (h1), seed 2, the checkpoint picked on the heavy check set by cooperative success (step 2002944, the last one).
policies.use: the push policy for the heavy box (the official push task); warm start for heavy-box work. It does not work on the light 0.15 kg box: use d2-push-l2-s2 there.

test_set.note: one deterministic episode per start, 200 clean heavy-box starts; experiments/d2-heavybox/h1-heavy-finetune/SUMMARY.md
